transcript.answer: Otto's `off` TMS mode was removed on 2026-10-16. Commit e773dd8 (Saad, 2026-10-16T11:30:25Z) dropped it from config, the chart, CI and the docs, following Lore's review of #403. `TMS_MODE` had been `off | stand-in | live` since commit 8bca080 on 2026-10-15, under #399. After e773dd8 it accepts only `stand-in` or `live`, and `get_booking_status` registers in every deployment.
